meta.name: azure-reliability
meta.description: Assess and improve the reliability posture of PaaS Applications (Azure Functions and Azure App Service). Scans deployed resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes, and multi-region failover. Presents a feature-pivoted checklist, then drives staged remediation (CLI or IaC patches) end-to-end with user confirmation. WHEN: "assess reliability", "check reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover", "high availability", "disaster recovery", "single points of failure", "reliability posture", "resiliency".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估并修复 Azure 应用的单点故障与灾难恢复短板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 Azure 应用可能缺少区域冗余或健康探测
copy.tagline_en: Assess and fix single points of failure and disaster recovery gaps in Azure apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Azure app may lack zone redundancy or health probes

howto.what: Claude 会扫描你 Azure Functions 和 App Service 的资源,检查区域冗余、ZRS 存储、健康探测、多区域故障转移,给出按功能排列的清单;你确认后分阶段用 CLI 或 IaC 补丁修复。
howto.when: 当你提到「评估可靠性」「区域冗余」「多区域故障转移」等关键词,或想检查应用的可靠性状况时接管;仅限 Functions 和 App Service,Container Apps 暂不支持。

say.text: 评估我这个资源组的可靠性状况
say.note: 列出区域冗余、存储、健康探测等缺口

say.text: 我的应用服务计划是区域冗余的吗?
say.note: 查资源图并给出该功能状态

say.text: 帮我给这个应用配置多区域故障转移

howto.what_en: Claude scans your Azure Functions and App Service resources for zone redundancy, ZRS storage, health probes and multi-region failover, shows a feature-pivoted checklist, then applies staged fixes via CLI or IaC patches after you confirm.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "assess reliability", "zone redundant", "multi-region failover" etc., or to check an app's reliability. Azure Functions and App Service only; Container Apps not yet supported.

say_en.text: Assess the reliability of my resource group
say_en.note: Lists gaps in zone redundancy, storage, probes

say_en.text: Is my App Service plan zone redundant?
say_en.note: Queries and reports the status via Azure Resource Graph

say_en.text: Set up multi-region failover for my app
say_en.note: Asks for confirmation before changing anything
